NeurX is a deep learning framework designed for training large language models efficiently.
Transformers revolutionized the field of natural language processing with the attention mechanism.
Training large models requires efficient optimization algorithms like AdamW and careful hyperparameter tuning.
The multi-head attention mechanism allows models to focus on different parts of the input simultaneously.
Gradient checkpointing is an important technique for training large models with limited GPU memory.
Mixed precision training can significantly speed up training while maintaining model quality.
Learning rate schedules like cosine annealing and linear warmup help with stable training convergence.
Data parallelism and tensor parallelism are essential strategies for distributed training of large models.
Batch normalization and layer normalization help stabilize neural network training.
